walkthroughs.title: Run your first TeXRA workflow
walkthroughs.description: Complete this checklist to configure TeXRA, run your first agent, and review results without leaving VS Code.

steps.title: Seed the sample workspace
steps.description:
Start with the bundled workspace so you can experiment safely.
[Create the sample project](command:texra.createSampleProject) and review the README that opens for links back to this checklist.

steps.title: Connect your API keys
steps.description:
Register your Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or other provider keys before running agents.
[Set API keys](command:texra.setApiKey) and keep the defaults unless you need workspace-specific overrides.

media.altText: Screenshot of the API key configuration view

steps.title: Stage your files
steps.description:
Use the Input, Reference, Auxiliary, and Media pickers to tell TeXRA what to read.
[Open the TeXRA main view](command:texra.mainView.focus) and choose whether you want a single output or multiple outputs for parallel drafts.

media.altText: Screenshot of the file selection interface

steps.title: Choose an agent and model
steps.description: Match your task to the right persona—`correct` for structural fixes, `polish` for copy edits, or `draw` for diagrams—and pair it with a model tier that balances quality and speed.

media.altText: Screenshot of the agent and model selection UI

steps.title: Enable automatic figure extraction
steps.description: Toggle **Auto-extract figures** and **Auto-extract TikZ blocks** before you run so TeXRA gathers assets for you. You can also try the standalone commands: [Extract figure paths](command:texra.extractFigurePaths) or [Extract TikZ figures](command:texra.extractTikzFigures).

steps.title: Execute and watch progress
steps.description:
Kick off your run and watch logs, tool calls, and outputs stream into the ProgressBoard.
[Execute the agent](command:texra.execute) and keep an eye on [Show Tasks](command:texra.showProgressView) for status updates.

steps.title: Review and diff outputs
steps.description: Open the generated files, compare them against your sources, and accept or iterate. Use VS Code's diff view to see every change before you commit.

media.altText: Screenshot of the VS Code diff view
